name: Novixa Addons for Elementor
author: Ali Hossain

sections.description:
Novixa Addons is an independent collection of creative, lightweight widgets for Elementor, with a clean dashboard for enabling only the elements you need. Every widget lives in its own module, so disabling the ones you don’t use keeps your site fast and your Elementor panel uncluttered.

All settings live under Novixa Addons in your wp-admin menu, with a dedicated Elements screen for toggling widgets on/off individually.

Text & Headings

  • Heading — a flexible heading widget with highlighted-text and sub-title support, plus alignment, typography, text stroke, text shadow, blend mode, and normal/hover colors.
  • Dual Color Heading — a heading split into two text runs, each with its own independent color, typography, and normal/hover states — useful for highlighting part of a title in an accent color.
  • Gradient Text Effect — a heading split into Beginning / Gradient / Ending text runs, with an adjustable two-color gradient clipped to the middle run.
  • Text Editor — a rich-text editor widget with drop-cap and column support, alongside alignment, typography, text shadow, paragraph spacing, and normal/hover colors.

Buttons

  • Button — a button widget with a Uiverse.io-style blob hover effect, including two built-in skins (Modern Solid gradient and Modern Outline).
  • Overlay Button — a button with a hover overlay effect, where a small color chip expands to fill the button on hover.
  • Icon Badge Button — a pill button with a permanently-visible colored circular icon badge on one end (e.g. a “Contact Us” button with an arrow badge). Choose from four hover effects — Icon Nudge, Badge Fills Button (a liquid-fill color sweep), or Color Change + Text Slide from the Top/Bottom/Left — and the badge icon itself slides out/in to match.

Icon Boxes & Feature Cards

  • Icon Box — a luxury icon box with icon shape, hover lift animation, box shadow, and normal/hover icon colors.
  • Diamond Icon Box — an icon box with a rotated diamond-outline icon shape, ideal for feature-grid sections.
  • Image Box — a luxury image box with hover zoom/grayscale effects and flexible left/right/top layout.
  • Feature Card — an icon-box style service/feature card with a title, description, and a CTA button that can overlap the card’s bottom-right corner.
  • Numbered Feature Box — a dark card with a colored icon badge, a large faint step number, a title and a description — built for numbered feature/benefit grids.
  • Image Caption Card — a full-bleed image card with a caption over a gradient scrim; switch on “Show Description” and “Show Button” to turn it into a premium Call-to-Action card, complete with hover lift, image zoom, and a gold-accented pill button.
  • Content Reveal on Hover — an image card whose title, description, and buttons stay tucked away until the visitor hovers (or focuses, for keyboard/touch users), then smoothly expand into view.

Accordions & Tabs

  • Accordion — a simple plus/minus accordion, with optional FAQ schema (JSON-LD) output.
  • Icon Accordion — expandable panels, each with its own icon, heading, and content.
  • Tabs — a set of labeled tabs with Direction, Justify, and Align Title layout controls.
  • Tabs (Nested, Experimental) — tabs where each panel is a real Elementor container you can drag any widget into. Requires the “Container” and “Nested Elements” experiments to be active in Elementor.

Counters & Stats

  • Counter — a premium animated count-up number with an optional icon, prefix/suffix and title. Counts up smoothly once it scrolls into view, and respects visitors’ “reduce motion” preference.
  • Liquid Counter — a circular stat badge with an animated gold “liquid fill” wave and a count-up number in the middle. The fill level is independent of the number itself, so a $106 and an 18 can sit side by side at the same visual level — great for a row of quick stats.

Marquees & Carousels

  • List Marquee — an infinitely-scrolling horizontal ticker of short items (room rates, announcements, offers), each with an optional icon and separated by a bullet. Adjustable speed and direction, with an option to pause on hover.
  • Logo Marquee — an infinitely-scrolling horizontal (or vertical) row of logo cards (brand, client, or partner logos), each in its own rounded card with an optional caption and link. Adjustable card size, speed, and direction, with options to pause on hover and grayscale-until-hover.
  • Images Marquee — an infinitely-scrolling gallery strip of plain images (a photo wall, portfolio strip, or “as seen in” band), rendered without a card frame. Same horizontal/vertical direction, speed, pause-on-hover and grayscale-until-hover options as Logo Marquee, plus its own width/height, object-fit, border, and shadow controls.
  • Logo Carousel — a paginated card carousel of logos with Prev/Next arrows and dot navigation, optional autoplay, adjustable slides-to-show/slides-to-change, a “Center Active Slide” mode, and custom arrow icons. Unlike Logo Marquee, this pauses on a fixed page instead of scrolling continuously.

Images & Comparisons

  • Before / After — a draggable image-comparison slider — two images in one frame, revealed with a drag handle — with a Height control so the frame is always a consistent size.
  • Image Gallery — a luxury filterable image gallery with a Grid or Masonry layout, a category filter bar, a hover overlay, and a built-in lightbox with navigation, a counter, and captions.

Blog & Posts

  • Post List — a WordPress post loop with four skins (Cards, Classic, List, Minimal), toggles for image/title/excerpt/meta/badge/avatar, category filtering, and a full pagination system: numbered, Previous/Next, Load on Click, or Infinite Scroll (AJAX-powered, no page reload). Can also switch its Source to Related Posts, automatically matching other posts by the current post’s categories/tags, with a fallback to latest posts when there’s nothing to relate to.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the novixa-addons-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Go to Novixa Addons > Elements to enable the widgets you want.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor (free version) must be installed and active.

Can I disable widgets I don’t use?

Yes, go to Novixa Addons > Elements and toggle any widget off. Disabled widgets are not loaded on the front end.

The Nested Tabs widget is marked experimental — why?

It relies on Elementor’s internal Nested Elements system rather than a stable public API, so its behavior can vary across Elementor versions and requires the “Container” and “Nested Elements” experiments to be enabled. All other widgets are fully stable.

Does Post List’s “Load on Click” / “Infinite Scroll” pagination slow down my site?

No — both fetch just the next page of posts over AJAX and append them to the existing list, without reloading the page. They also work correctly together with the “Related Posts” source and with multiple Post List widgets on the same page (via “Individual Pagination”).
sections.changelog:
1.5.2

  • New widget: Post List — a WordPress post loop with Cards/Classic/List/Minimal skins, full pagination (Numbers, Previous/Next, Load on Click, Infinite Scroll), and a “Related Posts” source mode
  • New widget: Logo Carousel — a paginated logo card slider with arrows, dots, autoplay, and a “Center Active Slide” mode
  • Fix: the “Alignment” control (Left/Center/Right) wasn’t visibly working in Icon Box, Diamond Icon Box, Counter, and Numbered Feature Box — flexbox’s align-items silently rejected left/right, and even once translated, wrapped title/description text stayed hardcoded centered. Both the block position and its text now move together.
  • Fix: Image Gallery lightbox close/prev/next icons were invisible on some browsers (a backdrop-filter compositing bug) — icons now render reliably
  • Fix: gallery zoom-icon SVGs switched from percentage-based to fixed sizing for consistent cross-browser rendering

1.5.1

  • New widget: Icon Badge Button — a pill button with a permanently-visible colored icon badge, with four hover effects (Icon Nudge, Badge Fills Button, and Color Change + Text Slide from Top/Bottom/Left)
  • Fix: Icon Badge Button’s icon color (and the same “Font Icon SVG” experiment issue previously fixed in Logo Carousel and Image Caption Card) – the badge icon’s fill/stroke now tracks the Icon Color control even when Elementor has converted it to an inline SVG with a baked-in color
  • Fix: Icon Badge Button’s badge could visually overflow past the button’s rounded edge at larger Badge Size values – button now has a min-height tied to the badge size so it always fits with room to spare
  • Fix: Icon Badge Button’s background-color wasn’t included in the hover transition, so it snapped instantly while text color and the icon/text slide animations eased smoothly – all three now animate together

1.5.0

  • New widget: Logo Carousel
  • Fix: same Alignment bug also found (by auditing the rest of the codebase for the identical pattern) in Numbered Feature Box’s flip-card “Alignment” control — Right selection silently failed to align text; now uses start/end instead of flex-start/flex-end so it works for both the block and its text
  • Fix: “Alignment” control (Left/Center/Right) wasn’t visibly working in Icon Box, Diamond Icon Box, and Counter — flexbox’s align-items silently rejected left/right, and even once translated, wrapped title/description text stayed hardcoded centered. Both the block position and the text now move together.
  • Logo Carousel: added Slides to Change, Center Active Slide, configurable Transition Speed, Item Image Size, global Open Link In New Tab, Lazy Load toggle, and custom Arrow Icons

1.4.0

  • Fix: Image Gallery lightbox close/prev/next icons were invisible on some browsers (backdrop-filter compositing bug) – backdrop-filter removed, icons now render reliably
  • Fix: gallery zoom-icon SVGs switched from percentage-based to fixed sizing for consistent cross-browser rendering

1.3.0

  • New widget: Feature Card
  • New widget: Before / After
  • New widget: Image Gallery

1.2.0

  • New widget: Liquid Counter
  • New widget: List Marquee
  • New widget: Logo Marquee
  • New widget: Images Marquee

1.1.0

  • New widget: Counter

1.0.2

  • New widget: Image Caption Card
  • New widget: Gradient Text Effect
  • New widget: Content Reveal on Hover

1.0.1

  • New widget: Dual Color Heading
  • New widget: Icon Box
  • New widget: Diamond Icon Box
  • New widget: Image Box
  • New widget: Button
  • New widget: Overlay Button
  • New widget: Icon Accordion
  • New widget: Accordion
  • New widget: Tabs
  • New widget: Tabs (Nested, Experimental)

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Heading and Text Editor widgets, dashboard, elements manager, settings screen.
